scope: Independent offline search, message location, date navigation and statistics connected to the recovered Alpha desktop UI
implementedBehavior: Case-insensitive literal global and conversation search
Cross-database stable pagination using create_time, database, table and local_id
Sender and inclusive millisecond time filters with cursor binding
Name2Id-only historical conversations and valid zstd text
Conversation grouping with real match counts
Exact source identities, uint64 server IDs and ambiguous locate rejection
Half-open calendar day counts, fixed UTC offsets and first/last message statistics
Explicit partial coverage for unreadable messages and unmapped tables
UI disclosure for partial results in all four search entry points
12 MiB JSON response guard with RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE and bounded sender joins
Shanghai and Los Angeles epoch/date boundary behavior
limitations: Synthetic SQLite fixtures only; no real WeChat directory, account or database key was used.
The timestamp-first ordering is an independent implementation choice and has not been proven identical to every original native ordering.
Search is a bounded scan without a persistent full-text index; larger datasets may require indexing work.
Structured XML, media, unknown subtypes, export, AI, write operations and automatic key acquisition remain unimplemented.
The original packaged backend remains blocked by its integrity policy; this stage does not alter its guard, signature or license.
